core_obligations: Build the commutative diagram of ringed topoi (proof lines 11508-11528): for U' in C' with image U = u(U'), consider the two one-object ringed topoi (Sh(pt), O'(U')) and (Sh(pt), O(U)) and square them with g; pullback along the lower horizontal arrow sends K to R Gamma(U, K) and pullback along the left vertical arrow sends M to M tensor^L_{O(U)} O'(U').

Read off the sections formula (proof lines 11529-11535): going around the square either way gives the same result by composition of derived pullbacks, hence R Gamma(U', Lg^*K) = R Gamma(U, K) tensor^L_{O(U)} O'(U') for every U' in C'.

Verify cartesianity (proof lines 11536-11550): for a morphism f' : U' -> V' in C' with image f : U -> V, the displayed chain of equalities rewrites R Gamma(V', Lg^*K) tensor^L_{O'(V')} O'(U') first by the formula at V', then by associativity of the derived tensor product, then by the quasi-coherence of K, and finally by the formula at U', obtaining R Gamma(U', Lg^*K) as required.
proof_roadmap: Compare the two ringed-topos squares over a single object U' of C'.
Use composition of derived pullbacks to obtain R Gamma(U', Lg^*K) = R Gamma(U, K) tensor^L_{O(U)} O'(U').
Plug this into the cartesianity identity for a morphism U' -> V' and use quasi-coherence of K to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived pullback Lg^* maps the quasi-coherent objects of D(O) into those of D(O') (statement lines 11500-11505). The proof (proof lines 11507-11550) is an explicit computation over a single object U' of C': the commutative diagram of ringed topoi built from U' and its image U gives R Gamma(U', Lg^*K) = R Gamma(U, K) tensor^L_{O(U)} O'(U') by composition of derived pullbacks, and the cartesianity identity for a morphism U' -> V' then follows by associativity of the derived tensor product together with the quasi-coherence of K. H2: one diagram computation followed by an associativity chain, all written out.
